_comment: It ships with NO evidence rows and NO operation records, and that is not an
oversight: this slice lands the MECHANISM, and the rows are ingested from
executed captures in a later slice. A registry that shipped pre-filled rows
would be asserting replay safety that no execution in this account observed.
Empty is also the safe state. Every consumer treats an absent row as
'unverified', which refuses a write retry. A registry that failed to load, or
loaded as empty, therefore denies rather than permits.

_provenance: Observed in 60 execution-connector rows across the archived captures for
this issue, every one from an execution that completed. The middle segment
is Boomi's official-connector publisher namespace, not the customer
account: the same segment appears on a different family
(officialboomi-X3979C-dbv2da-prod) in this repository's own goldens, and it
does not match this account's id. That is what makes the mapping portable
across accounts, which is the whole point of mapping to a family at all.
action_source is operation_component because the platform reports one
generic action for every HTTP verb; see the models module.

why: Present in this repository's goldens but NOT in any executed capture under
